title: Dimension of the comparison quotient fibre
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings with an R-algebra structure, q a prime of S, n,c natural numbers, and f a family of c equations in R[x_1,...,x_n]. Put T=R[x]/(f). Let π:T→S be a surjective R-algebra map and u∈T with π(u)∉q. Assume the canonical localization map T_u→S_{π(u)} is bijective and the local topological dimension at the canonical fibre prime of S over q∩R equals n-c. Then the local topological dimension at the canonical fibre prime of T over π⁻¹(q)∩R also equals n-c.

proof.text: Injectivity of the localized map implies every element a of ker π is annihilated by a power of u. Any prime not containing u therefore contains ker π. Surjectivity of π makes spectrum contraction an embedding, and its image consequently contains D(u). Restrict this embedding to the base fibre, then to this open neighbourhood; it is a homeomorphism there. The residue-field fibre homeomorphisms and invariance of local dimension under homeomorphisms and open subspaces identify the two canonical fibre dimensions. Apply the given dimension equality of the S fibre. All these assertions are proved as private helpers using Mathlib spectrum and topology lemmas.

lean.statement:
theorem equationCount_comparison_dimension
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S) {n c : ℕ} {f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R}
    (π : (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)) →ₐ[R] S)
    (u : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective π) (hu : π u ∉ q.asIdeal)
    (hbij : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalization.Away.mapₐ (Localization.Away u) (Localization.Away (π u)) π u))
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDimAt
      (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R S (q.comap (algebraMap R S)) ⟨q, rfl⟩) =
        (n - c : ℕ)) :
    topologicalKrullDimAt
      (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R
        (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))
        ((q.comap π.toRingHom).comap
          (algebraMap R (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))))
        ⟨q.comap π.toRingHom, rfl⟩) = (n - c : ℕ)
